sample.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where’s Natsuki?”

Sayori: “I honestly don’t have any clue.”

Yuri: “Monika, we should probably go check on her. Just the two of us.”

Monika: “You’re right, Yuri. We shouldn’t leave Natsuki alone if something’s wrong. Let’s head to the classroom and see if she’s still there.”

(Yuri nods in agreement, and the two of them make their way to the classroom. As the two of them leave, Sayori worriedly looks down at her round belly and puts a hand on it - noticing a lack of movement in her unborn triplets; Sora, Umi, and Tochi. Suddenly, she starts to feel intense pain in her stomach - despite being 7 months pregnant.)

Sayori: (gritting her teeth) “O-ow… something doesn’t feel right… the triplets… I need to call for help.”

(Sayori quickly takes out her phone and tries to dial emergency services, but her pain causes her to fumble and drop the phone into the closet.)

Sayori: “No, not now! I can’t reach the phone!”

(Sayori’s pain intensifies, and she starts to panic. She looks around, desperately searching for someone to help. She remembers that the clubroom is just next door and decides to try and call for Monika and Yuri.)

Sayori: “Monika! Yuri! Please, help me!”

(Sayori musters all her strength and starts crawling towards the clubroom. With each agonizing movement, the pain in her stomach worsens. She reaches the door and weakly bangs her hand on it, hoping someone will hear her.)

Sayori: “Please, someone, I need help! It’s an emergency!”

(As Sayori knocks on the door, her pain starts to get unbearable - until, after 5 agonizing minutes, she realizes what her pain was coming from.)

Sayori: “My water…my water just broke! The babies are coming…I…I don’t think I can make it to the hospital in time…”

(Sayori starts to panic even more, her mind racing with worries and fears. She desperately hopes that Monika and Yuri will hear her and come to her aid. With the last of her strength, she continues to knock on the door, tears streaming down her face.)

Sayori: “Please…help me…I can’t do this alone…”

(Sayori continues to knock on the door when, suddenly, her body starts to push the triplets out - causing her to let out an agonizing scream.)
sample.chosen:
(Monika and Yuri, still in the clubroom, hear Sayori's cries for help. They exchange worried glances and rush towards the door. Upon hearing Sayori's scream, they quickly open the door and find Sayori on the floor, in pain and with her water broken.

Monika: "Sayori! What's happening? Are you okay?"

Sayori: (through gritted teeth) "My water broke...the babies are coming...I don't think I can make it to the hospital in time..."

Yuri: "Don't worry, Sayori. We'll get you to the hospital as fast as we can."

Monika: "Yuri, call an ambulance right now. I'll help Sayori get to the car."

Yuri quickly grabs her phone and dials emergency services, explaining the situation to the operator. Monika helps Sayori to her feet, supporting her as they make their way to the school's entrance.

Sayori: (breathing heavily) "I'm so scared...I don't want to lose them..."

Monika: "We're not going to lose them, Sayori. We're going to get you to the hospital and everything will be okay."

As they reach the car, the ambulance arrives. The paramedics quickly assess the situation and help Sayori into the ambulance, promising to take her to the hospital as fast as possible.

Monika and Yuri follow the ambulance to the hospital, praying for the safety of Sayori and the triplets. Once they arrive at the hospital, they are greeted by a team of doctors and nurses who quickly take Sayori to the delivery room.

After a long and difficult labor, Sayori gives birth to three healthy babies: Sora, Umi, and Tochi. The doctors and nurses praise Sayori for her strength and bravery, and she is overjoyed to see her triplets safe and sound.

Monika and Yuri stay by Sayori's side throughout her recovery, helping her in any way they can. They are overjoyed to see Sayori and the triplets doing well, and they are grateful for the bond they have formed during this difficult time.

From that day on, Monika, Yuri, and Sayori are inseparable, vowing to always be there for each other no matter what. They are grateful for the miracle of life and the bond they have formed through their shared experience.)

rubric.analysis: 本任务要求针对提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club!》同人剧本片段（Stage: Revise）生成修订后的评分标准。核心交付物为符合特定JSON结构的评分体系，需覆盖剧本中Sayori临产危机的关键情节节点：包括三胞胎设定（Sora, Umi, Tochi）、胎动消失引发的腹痛、拨打急救电话失败及手机掉落、爬行求救的肢体动作、5分钟等待后的心理转折、羊水破裂的认知以及最终分娩开始的尖叫。评分标准需严格基于用户提供的文本事实，不引入外部医学常识或经验假设，仅核验剧本是否准确呈现了上述指定情节和逻辑链条。权重分配将依据情节在叙事中的关键程度进行非负数分配，确保总和为1。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本在结尾部分明确提到Sayori生下了三个健康的婴儿，并具体命名他们为Sora、Umi和Tochi。虽然剧本未直接重复“怀孕7个月”这一时间状语，但通过描述分娩过程及提及胎儿名字，确认了三胞胎的存在，且该信息与前文任务设定一致。

method.trigger: 当任务类型为故事续写、对话延续或基于给定文本片段的生成，且评分标准涉及具体情节节点时
method.principle: 评分标准中的情节核验项必须严格限定在 Prompt 结束后的‘新增内容’范围内，不得将 Prompt 中已明确描述的前置情节（如‘已发生’的动作或状态）作为回答必须再次呈现的强制条件，除非任务明确要求复述。
method.application_guide: Generator 在设计标准时，需先界定 Prompt 的叙事终点。对于该终点之前已发生的事件（如 Prompt 中 Sayori 已爬完并敲门），对应的评分标准应改为核验回答是否‘准确承接’该状态（例如：Monika 是否听到了敲门声），而非核验回答是否‘描述了’该动作本身。若 Prompt 已包含某细节，回答中未重复该细节不应视为扣分项，只有当回答错误地否认了该既定事实时才应扣分。
